notes.title: The Network Expansion and Racing Mayhem Analysis Log Starts NOW 🏎️💨
notes.content:
Hello lasagna lovers 🍝

It is time!

Let your engines roar! The Network Expansion and Racing Mayhem Analysis Log (or N.E.R.M.A.L.) Is Now Live!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636063/02e53418fd298ceee71403f24e20f2d3d53ff2e3.jpg
[hr][/hr]
How can I participate?
Simple!
Go to Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift’s Steam page
Hit “Request Access” on the game page to join Garfield Kart 2 - All You Can Drift - Network Expansion and Racing Mayhem Analysis Log
Download the Demo
Once installed, access it from your Steam Library

What can I expect to find?
3 Characters, representing each a weight category: Garfield (obviously, it’s his game after all), Nermal (we suspect he was involved with naming this program, but we haven’t found any conclusive evidence so far) and Liz (we needed someone somewhat responsible to keep the others in check)
2 Tracks - Western Spaghetti & Plate Runner
1 Kart with its customization options
Online Mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636063/02e53418fd298ceee71403f24e20f2d3d53ff2e3.jpg

When does the N.E.R.M.A.L. take place?
The N.E.R.M.A.L. will begin on August 21st 4pm CEST/10amET/7am PT and will be live until August 24th 11:59pm CEST/5:59pm ET/2:59pm PT.

Simple!
